timeline.cite: Silm 13; GA 52 §75 (HoME XI) [C] — 'that stronghold was called Nargothrond. Wherefore the Noldor named him Felagund, Lord of Caves'. The annal names him INGLOR; in the Grey Annals 'Finrod' means Finarfin, the father.

timeline.what: Finrod, shown Menegroth, delves Nargothrond in the caves of Narog

timeline.cite: [I-M] the archive's own reading of when the aftermath reached Nargothrond. AB2 dates Felagund's death to 464 ("264 [464] Here King Felagund and Beren son of Barahir were emprisoned in Tol-na-Gaurhoth by Thu, and King Felagund was slain"); the Grey Annals narrate the sequel undated -- "when the tidings came to Nargothrond of the death of Felagund... then Celegorn and Curufin were hated, and Orodreth took the crown of Nargothrond". No annal dates the usurpation or Orodreth's accession. Silm 19 narrates and dates nothing. Owner's ruling 31 Jul
timeline.what: Finrod goes with Beren; Celegorm and Curufin usurp the people's love; Orodreth rules after
